step_3d.converter_tooltip: Fallback external STEP→mesh command ({in} and {out}). Not required when pythonocc-core is installed.
step_3d.hint_mouse: Mouse: drag to rotate, wheel to zoom, middle or shift+drag to pan. Click a part or the assembly tree to highlight.
step_3d.msg_missing_pyvista: Optional viewer unavailable: install packages from requirements-step3d.txt (pyvista, pyvistaqt, vtk).
step_3d.msg_missing_converter: Set a converter command first (button «Converter…»). Use placeholders {in} (STEP path) and {out} (temporary .obj path).
step_3d.converter_dialog_help: Full command line with placeholders {in} (STEP path) and {out} (temporary .obj path VALVET passes). Quote placeholders if paths may contain spaces.
step_3d.msg_vtk_init_failed_short: The 3D viewer failed to start (window not ready or graphics error). Switch away from this tab and back, resize the window, or try QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb on Linux/Wayland.
step_3d.deflection_tooltip: Linear tessellation deflection in millimetres. Larger is faster and coarser (better for big PCBA STEP files).
step_3d.msg_missing_backend: Install pythonocc-core (requirements-step3d-occ.txt) or set an external STEP→mesh converter (button «Converter…»).
step_3d.msg_empty_mesh: No solid faces to display (the file may be wireframe-only).
step_3d.msg_large_file: This STEP file is large. Loading may take several minutes and a lot of RAM. Increase Mesh mm for a coarser, faster mesh.
project.pnp_layer_override_tip: When enabled, fills the column mapped to Layer after load: first word → rows from the first PnP file, second word → rows from the second file. Leave empty for T on file 1 and B on file 2. Changing this reloads PnP from disk when a primary file is loaded.
project.pnp_select_optional: Optional second PnP file (e.g. other board side)
project.pnp_topbot_help: Optional second PnP file is the other board side. Use «Set layer per file» to assign layer tokens (e.g. top bot), map a column to Layer on the PnP tab, then use Merge → Export Top/Bot with the matching layer values.
msg.pnp_secondary_need_primary: Load the primary PnP file before attaching a second file.
msg.pnp_layer_override_no_column: Layer override is on but no column is mapped to Layer — map a column to Layer, or use files that include a Layer column.
project.debug_logs_hint: Same as --debug: write logs/YYYY-MM-DD.log and verbose stderr. Also shows debug lines in this console.
wip.banner: Work in progress (ALPHA). Hanwha MDB editor and PCB Preview are experimental; expect rough edges while core BOM/PnP features stabilize.
bom.clear_workspace_tip: Unload BOM from the workspace (table and column mapping). Loaded file paths are not stored in profiles.
pnp.clear_workspace_tip: Unload PnP from the workspace (table and column mapping). Loaded file paths are not stored in profiles.
pnp.separator_tip: space = one ASCII space field; spaces = classic SPACES (any whitespace); 2+sp = Eagle/cmp split on 2+ spaces.
msg.bom_clear_confirm: Clear the BOM table and column mapping? This cannot be undone.
msg.pnp_clear_confirm: Clear the PnP table and column mapping? This cannot be undone.
msg.profile_empty_kept_ui: Profile "{name}" has no saved UI state yet; keeping the current layout.
msg.profile_load_failed: Could not load profile UI state: {err}
msg.profile_cannot_delete_default: The built-in "default" profile cannot be deleted.
msg.profile_delete_confirm: Delete profile "{name}" and its saved UI state?
debug.experimental_note: Choose which optional main tabs are created when VALVET starts. Turning a tab off avoids loading its heavy code (PCB Preview: Gerber stack; Step 3D: VTK/PyVista). **Restart the application** after changing these options.
debug.fonts_note: The two groups below are independent. **Main UI** applies to chrome, combos, and line edits. **Data tables** applies to spreadsheet-style views (BOM/PnP tables, tree views, column headers). The **Project** console always uses JetBrains Mono (or a system monospace fallback). Fetch fonts: `tools/fetch_inter.py` (Inter), `tools/fetch_jetbrains_mono.py` (Mono).
debug.colours_note: Colours are stored in the **active profile** (same JSON as language/BOM prefs). Use **#RRGGBB** (or **#RGB**). Table colours fix alternating row contrast on dark theme. **Apply** saves the profile immediately.
debug.colours_saved_profile: Colours saved to the active profile.
debug.none_selected: Select one or more snapshots in the list.
debug.confirm_delete_body: Delete {n} snapshot pair(s) from autosave? This cannot be undone.
debug.recover_none: No dirty working-copy snapshots found for the current BOM/PnP session links.
debug.recover_confirm_body: Load {n} dirty snapshot(s) into the current BOM/PnP tables where paths match?
clean.source_hint: Map a BOM column to Comment, then Import → Convert → Apply.
clean.import_done: Preview: raw values from BOM column(s) {columns} — {count} row(s). {range} Click Convert to run classifiers and cleaning.
clean.convert_done: Last import: column «{column}»; table shows post-Convert results ({count} rows). {range}
clean.apply_ok_banner: Cleaned data applied to the BOM tab (see «comment» column).
clean.apply_replaced: Clean BOM: replaced {count} value(s) in source column «{column}»
clean.apply_added: Clean BOM: updated {count} value(s) in «comment» plus clean_type / clean_part_code / clean_vendor
clean.watt_from_pack_tip: When watt is missing, fill from chip size (0402→1/16W). Off by default. Does not change vendor MPN watt codes.
clean.help_body:
Uses the BOM column mapped to Comment.

1. Import — copy raw Comment into the preview.
2. Convert — run classifiers and formatting.
3. Apply — write cleaned values back to the BOM.

Everyday settings (library lookup, part numbers, R/C/L, join character) are under Settings. Pipeline debug is in Advanced.
clean.advanced_debug_tip: Pipeline steps and components library path.
clean.from_db_tip: Look up learned components from the local library. Override the file path in Advanced (pipeline debug).
clean.from_machine_tip: Match BOM text to names from the Machine lib tab. Load a library there first; unmatched rows fall through to other rules.
clean.pn_tip: Decode vendor part numbers. Pipeline order is set in Advanced.
clean.pn_vendor_tip: When Part numbers is on, this only changes the Source column label (vendor vs pn).
clean.prefix_spacer_tip: On: prefix C + spacer + 0402-12PF. Off: C0402-12PF.
clean.double_comment_tip: Merge every BOM column mapped to Comment into one line. Needs two or more Comment mappings.
clean.partial_match_tip: When machine library lookup is on, try a fuzzy match if the exact name is missing.
clean.resistor_tip: Off: resistor formatting is skipped for classified resistor rows.
clean.capacitor_tip: Off: capacitor formatting is skipped for classified capacitor rows.
clean.ohm_r_tip: Keep a trailing R on plain ohm values (12.5R). Does not change K/M suffixes.
clean.cap_uf_micro_tip: Show microfarads with µF instead of uF.
clean.btn_import_tip: Read the BOM column mapped to Comment into the preview.
clean.btn_convert_tip: Run classifiers and formatting on imported comments.
clean.btn_apply_tip: Write cleaned values to the BOM (extra columns, or replace the source column).
clean.replace_source_tip: On: write Cleaned into the source Comment column. Off: add *_cleaned and clean_* columns.
clean.btn_learn_tip: Append the selected OTHER row to the component library.
